scope: captured browser protocol and confirmed ordinary/cascade state machine; special modes without adjacent raw evidence remain disabled

baseUrl.runtimeRule: the launch query sip supplies the API host; the front end appends /api/v1 paths

response.success: HTTP 2xx and String(code)==200 resolves data or {}
response.failure: other code rejects; 401 stops heartbeat; 403/503 info is retained; missing JSON code becomes HTTP<status>

encryption.basis: raw bodies are readable form/JSON and front-end HTTP code contains no crypto transform

tokenPhases: auth/verify form t is the launch token
auth/verify data.token is the session token
config/spin/history form t is that session token

requestOrder.effect: initialize bets, payouts, buy metadata, currency and optional last state

requestOrder.precondition: config loaded and player starts/continues a Round

requestOrder.condition: repeat automatically while previous response ss=0
requestOrder.effect: deliver next queued Step without another debit

requestOrder.condition: user opens History and selects a transfer_id
requestOrder.effect: load generated Round summaries and adjacent Steps

responseDataFields.rc: captured object {on,v}; broader semantics not inferred

endpoints.activeResumeStatus: PARTIAL: code branch known but only terminal last captured

requestFields.bm: optional buy selector 4..7; code-discovered, not captured

responseDataFields.afnl: free-add annotation list; empty in captures
responseDataFields.ba: charged Step amount; paid start bl*bs*20, later Steps zero
responseDataFields.frwa: free aggregate field; zero in captured paid Rounds
responseDataFields.fsn,nfsc: free total/current counters; zero in captures
responseDataFields.gm,gt: captured numeric metadata; broader enums unknown
responseDataFields.nrsc,rsn: summon current/total counters; zero in captures
responseDataFields.pb: player balance after this Delivery's settlement point
responseDataFields.rpx: multiplier state consumed by client; absent in captured Steps
responseDataFields.small_game_type: 0 on captured paid start; 1 on cascade continuation/terminal Steps
responseDataFields.syxl: split coordinate list; partial lifecycle only
responseDataFields.wskl: present but empty in all captured Steps

endpoints.implementationDisposition: response shape UNKNOWN except client checks optional version
request os/om is code-discovered; response shape UNKNOWN

states.meaning: auth token and player are available
config loaded and no active Round
a complete generated Round has queued undelivered Steps
free/summon/buy state indicated by fields but protocol not captured; must not be generated

transitions.event: CONFIG code=200 with no active last

terminationRules: ss=1 terminates the current ordinary/cascade Round
captured cascade terminal Step has wa=0,wmkl=[],ba=0 and retains final rwa
captured independent LOSS terminates on paid Step 1 with wa=rwa=0 and wmkl=[]
free/summon termination is UNKNOWN because no adjacent evidence exists

winAndBoard.board: 5 reels x 3 visible rows, rskl length 15, column-major
winAndBoard.wild: substitutes ordinary symbols; self-pays only on 5 reels per current spl/code
winAndBoard.cascade: winning cells identified by wmkl are removed by presentation; next server Step supplies the resulting full rskl

roundEvidence.shape: three-Step cascade with split movement and wn=1
two-Step cascade with terminal balance credit

unresolved.missing: nonterminal last sample and following Delivery
bm request/response and full purchased Round

runtimeProhibitions: Never read, rotate, sample, copy or hard-code fixtures/captures as runtime outcomes.
Winning/cascade Rounds must be generated completely once and then delivered from their own active queue.
Only a confirmed ordinary paid independent LOSS may be generated in real time while READY.
Do not generate any partial/unknown special mode.
Do not treat the constant 20 as a payline count or front-end weights as proven server probabilities.
